Equipment.description: One thing an agent is given (S-0062/D-1).

kind.description:
Where the harness puts it. A kind the harness does not accept is refused
against its manifest, not here (S-0062/D-2).
kind.title: Kind

ref.description:
What the source pins it at, in the source's own vocabulary — a tag, a branch,
a commit. Required for a fetched source and refused for the two that carry a
version already.
ref.title: Ref

select.description: The subset of the source to take; empty takes everything it holds.
select.title: Select

Equipment.title: Equipment

description:
What the agent is (S-0061/D-1) — never how it runs.

A seat naming no profile resolves the profile named for the task's role
(S-0061/D-11), so `implement`, `review` and `revert` are the names that
carry a repository's defaults.

equipment.title: Equipment

prepare.description:
A command run in the sandbox before the agent, on its own clock — an index
built, a cache warmed. Its failure is an infrastructure failure and convicts
nothing (S-0062/D-7); chained into the harness command it would be booked as a
gate-red conviction instead.
prepare.title: Prepare

prompt_extras.description:
Working rules appended after the charter's base rules — never before, never
replacing them (S-0061/D-4).
prompt_extras.title: Prompt Extras
